name: Brand Studio Edition
positioning: The release page for @brand-studio/ui 0.2.0: 44 React components that take their colours, type and corners from a brand contract.
audience: Front-end developers and designers choosing a component library for a branded React app, site or AI product.
voice: One job per chapter, named the way a person would say it
Short lines; the components carry the proof

direction.concept: Modern interface inside old paintings: each chapter's component sits in the hands of a public-domain painting, in ultramarine, the pigment those painters prized.
direction.tier: Set-piece release edition. Structure studied from Shopify Editions Winter '26 (pinned painted stage, chapter index, torn paper, dense release grid); art and copy are our own.
devices: Ultramarine props: the live component for each chapter is anchored to a point in the painting and moves with the camera
Tile wave: between paintings square tiles flip in a diagonal wave from the bottom left, ultramarine edge-on, to reveal the next one
Torn paper: each chapter's demo panel tears in over the painting
invariants: Public-domain museum paintings only, credited in each chapter and in the footer
Instrument Serif for headlines, Geist for everything else
Ultramarine only on components, the current chapter and the primary action
Every component on the page is live and from the published package
variables: Which painting and component each chapter uses
Camera path and ambient light per painting

imagery.subject: Public-domain paintings from The Met and the National Gallery of Art, one per chapter, chosen for a gesture that matches the chapter's job
imagery.materials: Oil and tempera on panel and canvas; laid paper for the demo panels
imagery.lighting: The paintings' own light, with a slow ambient layer per painting: a gold sweep, leaf shade or candle flicker
imagery.palette: Paper #ecebe5, ink #141413, ultramarine #2c3bf5 on the components only
invariants: Museum's own image, rights line recorded in source-art
No invented facts about a painting; each caption comes from the museum record
avoid: Generated imitations of a living artist
Jokes at the expense of the paintings' religious subjects

motion.character: Opening: tiles flip out of the dark into the feast, then the camera pulls back while the title card draws in. Chapters: each painting stays pinned for two screens while the camera moves toward the chapter's gesture and the component rides with it. Between paintings a wave of square tiles flips from the bottom left, ultramarine edge-on, to reveal the next one.
motion.reducedMotion: Each painting shows at rest with its component in place; transitions become a cut; the demo panels are unchanged.
